audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra priestly rupture text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Nadab and Abihu's strange fire, priestly grief restrictions, alcohol/service warning, teaching discernment, remaining offering dispute, and Moses accepting Aaron's grief logic.

verses.restored: Nadab and Abihu, sons of Aaron, each took his firepan, put fire in them, placed incense upon it, and brought near before YHWH strange/unauthorized fire, which he had not commanded them.

familiar.text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

verses.restored: Fire came out from before YHWH and consumed them, and they died before YHWH.

familiar.text: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

verses.restored: Moses said to Aaron, This is what YHWH spoke, saying, By those near me I will be sanctified, and before all the people I will be honored. Aaron was silent.

familiar.text: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

verses.restored: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Uzziel uncle of Aaron, and said to them, Come near, carry your brothers from before holy place to outside camp.

familiar.text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

verses.restored: They came near and carried them in their tunics to outside camp, as Moses spoke.

familiar.text: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

verses.restored: Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar his sons, Do not loosen hair of your heads and do not tear your garments, lest you die and wrath come upon all congregation; but your brothers, all house of Israel, shall weep for the burning that YHWH burned.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.

verses.restored: From entrance of tent of meeting you shall not go out, lest you die, for anointing oil of YHWH is upon you. They did according to word of Moses.

familiar.text: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Aaron, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,

verses.restored: Wine and strong drink you shall not drink, you and your sons with you, when you come into tent of meeting, so you do not die; age-long statute throughout your generations,

familiar.text: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

verses.restored: and to distinguish between holy and common, between unclean and clean,

familiar.text: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

verses.restored: and to teach children of Israel all statutes that YHWH spoke to them by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

verses.restored: Moses spoke to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his remaining sons, Take grain offering remaining from fire-offerings of YHWH and eat it unleavened beside altar, for Holy of Holies it is.

familiar.text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:

verses.restored: You shall eat it in holy place, for it is your due and your sons' due from fire-offerings of YHWH, for so I was commanded.

familiar.text: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.

verses.restored: Breast of wave offering and thigh of contribution you shall eat in clean place, you and your sons and daughters with you; for as your due and your sons' due they are given from sacrifices of peace/well-being offerings of children of Israel.

familiar.text: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons’ due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

verses.restored: Thigh of contribution and breast of wave offering, upon fire-offerings of fat portions, they shall bring to wave as wave offering before YHWH; it shall be for you and your sons with you as age-long due, as YHWH commanded.

familiar.text: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.

verses.restored: Moses diligently sought goat of sin/misalignment offering, and look, it had been burned. He was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's remaining sons, saying,

familiar.text: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

verses.restored: Why did you not eat sin/misalignment offering in holy place? For Holy of Holies it is, and he gave it to you to carry iniquity of congregation, to make atonement/covering for them before YHWH.

familiar.text: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

verses.restored: Look, its blood/life was not brought into holy place inside; eating, you should have eaten it in holy place, as I commanded.

familiar.text: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.

verses.restored: Aaron spoke to Moses, Look, today they brought near their sin/misalignment offering and burnt offering before YHWH, and such things happened to me. If I had eaten sin/misalignment offering today, would it have been good in eyes of YHWH?

familiar.text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?

verses.restored: Moses heard, and it was good in his eyes.

familiar.text: And when Moses heard that, he was content.

translation_notes: Strange/unauthorized fire is defined only as what YHWH had not commanded; avoid speculative certainty beyond text.
Aaron's silence should be preserved as grief/shock, not consent or lack of feeling.
The house of Israel is permitted to weep; priestly restriction is role-specific and ethically difficult.
Wine/strong drink prohibition follows rupture and relates to priestly discernment/teaching, but do not overclaim causality unless audited.
Moses accepts Aaron's refusal to eat after tragedy, showing grief can interrupt ritual expectation.
safety_note: Do not use Nadab and Abihu to terrorize people with arbitrary Divine violence or to suppress grief. The chapter is a severe priestly-boundary narrative; it also preserves communal mourning and Moses accepting Aaron's grief-shaped discernment.
